```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("nyc_airbnb")
```

## some questions

most expensive / cheapest
highest concentration
most / best review
number increased / descreased over time

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  count(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |>
  count(room_type, neighbourhood) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
```

##price

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(price)) |>
  filter(price_rank < 3)
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  group_by(neighbourhood_group) |>
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(desc(price))) |>
  filter(price_rank < 10)
```



```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(price < 1000) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = price)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_grid(room_type ~ neighbourhood_group)
  
```


price average

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  group_by(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |>
  summarize(
    mean_price = mean(price)
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = mean_price
  )
  
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |>
  filter(price < 500) |>
  filter(room_type != "Shared room") |>
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(. ~ room_type) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

##visualize price some more
map
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |>
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  filter(price < 500) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lat, y = long, col = price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(
    name = "price"
  )
```

##leaflet map

```{r}
library(leaflet)

pal = colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = 1 : 500
)

nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |>
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  filter(price < 500) |>
  sample_n(50) |>
  leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(~lat, ~long,color = ~pal(price), radius = 0.5)

```
